column1: # WP-56: the runtime slice's jmp_buf-translating shims -- curated, not
# derived, in the pattern of runtime/face/ctx.tsv. Each row names the
# binding, target Cygwin export and bind-table index), plus the two
# properties that table does not: which shape of frameless face the row
# takes (save allocates lazily and reads one argument; restore reads two
# and never allocates) and the row's sbind (weak/global), which the
# forward map carries but the generated shims worklist does not. A drift
# between this table and wire-runtime.shims.tsv (a symbol renamed, added
# or dropped) is caught by gen-jmpbuf-face.sh refusing to run rather than
# silently emitting a stale or partial face.
